reviews.comment: I absolutely love Dr.K and his class is as easy as biochem can be. He often went through lecture material as fast as possible which left me with a decent gap in knowledge to what's needed for 411/MCAT. Very kind prof & passionate about his research, just wish he put more into the lectures. If you have an easy sem ahead, take Pozzi. If not, Kurouski

He lectures in an extremely rushed manner yet tests all of the content he "covered." Tested extra content not included in the syllabus bcs we "had extra time" when he had poorly explained every concept prior. Overall isn't a great teacher and his tests can have extremely low yield concepts, but are generally doable. no extra credit unlike last year

Dr. Kurouski was AMAZING please take him if you can!!! He gives LOTS of extra credit, so go to class and pay attention to what he says because anything could show up on the test! The extra credit and real life examples he gives help alot with understanding the material as well!!! 10/10 would take again

Biochemistry is one of the hardest courses I've taken, but Dr. Kurouski made me learn the concepts very well. He is extremely passionate and makes the class engaging and informative. Although attendance is not mandatory, attending lectures makes a huge difference. His exams are challenging but very fair!

A lot of the reviews are forgetting that biochemistry is a HARD subject, and forgetting Kurouski makes it more bearable!!  It is very test-heavy, and the test comes straight from the slides, with extra credit coming from what he says in lecture. Overall, I had a great experience in the class and would recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class is overall pretty easy. Exams are based off of slides. Some obscure things from slides could come up so make sure you know everything on the slides. Lectures well and is funny. Has a lot of stories to talk about during class time so you'll be entertained at the very least. Exams have extra credit at the end which are from his lectures.

Dr. Kurouski's class, in one word can be described as FAIR. Biochemistry is extremely in depth, so not sure why many people are expecting an easy A. Dr. Kurouski makes it digestible, and also integrating it with current research he does, which is super fun to learn about! Would recommend, just be prepared to study :) (as expected with biochem lol)

His lectures are boring but easy to prepare for exams by studying for the slides and redoing the homework (has 3 attempts). bonus Q come STRAIGHT from lecture (verbally). Its biochem so its hard but very doable to get an A with kurouski!! Idk why there is a lot of hate directed at him, he was pretty funny and engaging with ALOT of bonus!!!

He is a bad lecturer and expects you to know tiny details from his slides. On top of that, he doesn't even have his own slides he just uses all of Pozzi's material. Probably the best choice for BICH 410 difficulty wise, but you probably won't learn much. Btw, he will not curve your grade even if you end with an 89.9
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I did not perform amazing in this course, as it was very difficult and extremely test heavy. Lots of material in little time. At the end of the day he truly does care about his students and tries to help you out. Very hard course overall, but not impossible.

He doesn't really lecture, so try and get ahold of Pozzis videos to understand content. He likes to talk more about his research than class content and is very smart but won't teach you content well. Tests aren't too bad, but you do need to study hard for them.

Not bad prof especially considering your other choices. Exam averages were Bs which is pretty high for a 400 level class. If you put in the time to study you will do well especially considering how many bonus points he gives on midterms. Just make sure you actually study the slides because he pulls directly from those.
Honestly not a bad prof. Just study the slides and old exams. Exam averages were in the 80s. Lots of EC on regular exams. Just a hard class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall he is the best choice out of other profs. Yes he goes through lecture quickly, but regardless, if you study the slides for the exam, you will do well. Exam questions typically use same wording as slides. Exam 3 is the most dense so study more in advance. Exam questions are very detail oriented as well, so catch the details while studying.

He DEF changed the class since previous terms. Goes super fast in lec & let us out 20 mins early every day. Often goes back on things that he tells us (EX there would be bonus Q on the final, but then decided to take it away). Very disappointing. I went to office hrs to ask him a question & he didn't know how to solve the problem from HIS OWN EXAM.

He speeds through lectures and relies on whiteboard drawings that are hard to see in a large lecture hall. Exams are taken on laptops at very small desks, making it difficult to manage a laptop, scratch paper, and a calculator at the same time. Biochem is already difficult, but he manages to make it harder. Choose Pozzi instead.

He is a very nice professor, but he sped through lectures too fast and did not spend a lot of time on the more complex topics of biochemistry. The tests were hard and sometimes had material on it that he did not go over. I took him because I heard such good reviews, but in the end, I personally felt his lectures were not optimal.

Lectures weren't good, goes super fast, skims over things, goes on tangents and proceeds to say "this won't be on the exam. He made his exams a lot harder than they should be since he doesn't even go over the material clearly. Also really unorganized with the slides, never posts the one he uses. (even though they're pozzi's anyways). I would pass.

Kurouski is definitely better than Miles, but this class was made hard by the professor. If you take him, don't believe what he says in class about the exam, cause he'll do the exact opposite. Better off taking Pozzi cause her lectures prepare you for exams. He uses Pozzi material anyway, and that's how most of us studied.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Now, I didn't put in enough in this class than I should've, but I feel that his lectures weren't too helpful (at least for me). He would skim through some of the slides in a lecture and barely teach about it sometimes , but those same topics would be seen in the exam later on. He is funny, gives extra credit (on exams), and has practice exams.

This professor does not care about his students one bit and would rather see them drop from the class rather than help them out. Although attendance isn't mandatory, he tried scaring the class and sending a message in canvas saying -5 points for those that didn't show up to class, pure evil. Does not help in office hours.

I have a 4.0 gpa as a senior, and I *still* had to drop the class. He goes very fast during lecture and just doesn't do a good job at explaining anything. The average for each exam were Bs, but unfortunately teaching myself the material wasn't enough. I need quality lectures to learn, so I struggled, but other students did good. He's very nice tho!
Take him!!!

Kurouski is the funniest and most chill dude ever. Lectures are enjoyable and he makes the content digestible. His exams often have repeat questions from old exams, which he provides on Canvas. Top 2 professor I've ever taken.

Great guy and very funny! Made exams very easy and would actually tell you what's on the exam and what to study. I would take him again but my only complaint is since he doesn't teach 411 he under-preparred me for Pozzi's 411 and the MCAT!
Best science prof I've ever had! Lectures are interesting and fun. Extra credit on every exam, including the final. Practice exams and TA reviews are great resources to study for the exams.
Dr. Kurouski was hilarious. If you can, you're gonna want to take him for BICH410. Absolute king

TAKE HIM! If u have to take it in person get him. 1 Hw due before every exam (3 attempts), and 3 lecture exams (study the old exams he posts) + 1 cumulative final (extremely doable). Extra credit on all exams. NOT BORING AT ALL, engaging,  2nd exam is the hardest, start studying days after the 1st exam.compile notes after lecture
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: GOAT. Take him for 410 you wont regret it
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Kurouski was phenomenal. Best professor I have ever had. He really cares about his students and makes biochemistry fun. Each exam has built-in bonus questions that give a lot of room for grades. Just go to class and pay attention to what he says and you will get an A

Dr. Kurouski makes a sincere effort to get his students engaged in biochemistry and is extremely accessible. It is very clear he cares about us and wants us to be successful. Biochemistry is a difficult subject, but it is extremely helpful having a down-to-earth professor that is more than willing help students.
Kurouski was great. He gives bonus points on each exam, and the exams are based on lecture materials. Very funny too, kept class entertaining.

the best professor ever. his exams are directly covered from his slides and he offers extra credit on all of them. the final exam is questions from past exams. he is so kind and caring for his students

Honestly your best bet for biochem 410, amazing lecturer, great at engaging students and not droning on. Graded on only 3 exams, each of which have extra credit, and 3 homework grades. Really nice guy who cares about his students.

This guy is pure gold. Aside from being funny and down to earth, he is super easy to get ahold of outside of class. I constantly just showed up to his office and asked questions. Any BICH class is difficult, but Dr. Kurouski made this one rather enjoyable compared to the horror stories I hear from other professors. Take him if you can!

Kurouski is one of the best professors I've had at Texas A&M. He really cares about his students and his research, which makes his lectures excellent. He's excited about the material and always cracking jokes which keeps your attention. I looked forward to going to class every day. His exams are difficult just because it's biochem, but VERY doable.

Dr. Kurouski was probably one of the best choices I could've made when choosing a biochemistry professor. I may have gotten a B, but an A is very achievable. I wish I had pushed a little harder for it. He gives a lot of opportunities to have a good grade in the class.
This class was hard simply because it was biochem but Dr. Kurouski made it fair. The homework and quiz grades are what saved my grade. Go to class and you can definitely make an A.

lets be honest... biochemistry is DIFFICULT. but I cannot recommend Dr. Kurouski enough! He is a character and will crack jokes left and right, which can make lectures fun! Humor aside, he really knows his stuff and wants his students to succeed. He gives bonus questions on every exam, so go to class to get the answers. TAKE HIM for BICH410.

Dr. Kurouski is passionate about his research and seems to be even more passionate about teaching. I will say, if you are one that tends to skip lectures, don't even think about taking this guy. I am not sure how he was online, but for in-person, everything is on the slides. Granted, the slides are super long, but he is the best for BICH for sure.
Gives extra credit in every exam. Lot of slides but he emphasizes and tells you exactly whats on exam if you go to class. Best biochem prof hands down
Great prof
The absolute BEST professor I have EVER had! This guy definitely cares about his students and is the best prof by far for biochem 1. MUST TAKE!

nice guy, but if you're looking for someone who can actually TEACH, then hes not for you. First 2 exams imo were ok but the 3rd exam was a complete change from his style of testing (harder) Questions were so specific that you had to memorize every single thing on his slides to get a good grade. went from an A to a B 2 weeks before the final

Loved Dr. Kurouski until exam 3. He threw huge curveballs (roman numeral style questions) that caused a lot of people to fail. He said the exam was hard because people didn't show up to recitation (which was 1. unfair and 2. unhelpful due to the recitation being Q&A style). He did not test knowledge, only memorization of large amounts of material.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I started this class really hoping to enjoy the material. We were required to watch three recorded lectures and attend three recitation lectures a week, with a quiz every Monday, and it became obvious that the TA and professor were not communicating. Exams were unlike the homework, quizzes, or practice questions provided. Worst class I've taken.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Expects you to go to 3 hours of recitation per week during normal class hours and watch 3 hours of lectures during your own time. Overworked TA - he put her in charge of 150 students, all quizzes, and the testing time limits. Extra credit interfered with exam time and was Extra difficult. If you have a choice, don't take him. If not, good luck!

His class is an actual joke. I have learned absolutely nothing from him. Hes very nice and funny but he sucks as a teacher at least online. He doesnt write his tests and his lectures arent helpful at all because he speeds through them in 20 min and skips half the slides. I was so excited for this class and now I want nothing more than to be done

So i think he is probably a better lecturer in person. The prerecorded lectures were boring/too fast/hard to follow. I learned almost exclusively from AK videos, Khan academy, etc. The tests are fair and he is generous with bonus on each test. He's a nice guy tho, he jokes around about making students cry which I guess some ppl take seriously.
Not a great professor. HIs lecture does not help you prepare the exam.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Many people have written that he is a harsh prof, which could not be further from the truth. He is very caring & willing to help you out. You of course have to study hard. Biochemistry is not an easy class by any means. He is hilarious & sarcastic which may be why the sensitive people felt he was rude. He is not rude. He is a great prof. Take him!

He is the worst professor I've had so far. Lecture videos went from being 30 min to 18 min. Skips over so many slides during his videos. He says he wants us to hate him. That is not a "flex," hun. He definitely cares about his research more than his students. Pretty sure he just laughs over bad reviews and doesn't actually learn from them.

Pros: Dr. Kurouski is a cool guy, offers extra credit on each test, homeworks are easy and weighted heavily Cons: Communication with TA was bad at first, tests are unreasonably specific, goes way too fast in online lectures, does not curve. This is a hard class, but with the circumstances of this semester, he could've thrown us a bone. Study Hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr.K is a funny and nice professor except sometimes his sarcasm may tend to hurt. First two exams went well, but then he totally switched up on and made the 3rd exam impossibly hard due to his recitation attendance being lower. I have never been in a class where I got punished because other people did not bother attending lectures. went from A to B

Take Dr. K. Out of anyone else just take this man for BICH 410. That being said, don't come into BICH 410 thinking it is going to be easy. Watch lectures, go to recitations, and study with someone else and do not study alone. You can make an A in this class if you put in more effort than most other classes you've taken before. Nice guy, and helpful

Best professor I have ever had at Texas A&M in my whole college career. I always look forward to the recitation sections with this guy, very funny and kind all around. He is very knowledge and wants you to do well and actually learn the material. I wish this guy taught all of my classes.

I am not even sure if I am going to pass his class. I have never been in this position before. He is literally the worst professor I have ever had. I had to get on anxiety medication due to his class. He seems nice but he is actually pretty mean (he talks about making us cry). He makes fun of us and responds very shortly and rudely to emails.

Dr. K rlly wants everyone to do well in his class, and he's a nice guy. He can also be very sarcastic at times, which some didn't appreciate, but it matched my sense of humor. He gives at least 30pts of extra credit, the hmwks easy grade boosters, and the exams tricky but doable. Ppl complained about recitation way too much, but the quizzes were ez
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Terrible experience. He seemed like a cool guy but then would mention that he was excited to watch us sweat and cry during the tests. He told us to get ready to cry when we hit submit on the exams. He was right. I studied an extreme amount and still failed every exam. I took his class very seriously and still did very bad. Very disappointed.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: As nice as Dr. K is, his class online is a total mess. It seemed like there was little communication between him and the TA, who did most of the teaching. Weekly quizzes over things not discussed at all in lecture, and little help understanding. He's a great guy, I just don't think he adjusted his class to fit an online format at all.

He promised that the exams will be easier through the semester, but made the exams harder. Although attending recitations are not required, he got mad at us since students not attending recitations. He punished us by making exams harder without telling us when/why/how he's mad. Exams are not related to HW/quiz and NOT for testing performance.

Do not take this prof if you want to enjoy biochemistry or if you value your mental health. Worst experience I've had with a course by far. He has simply failed to adjust to the online format. He made me despise the subject that would have been my favorite. Need more characters to describe all the shortcomings of this class.

Dr. K is a really interesting guy, I genuinely like him. I'm not sure if it's the online classroom this fall semester. I'm a 4.0 student and this is my first B ever. Lectures are VERY fast and pre-recorded (Worthless if I'm honest). Exams are not written by him and are NOT what he emphasize in lectures. HW is a joke and not indicative of ANYTHING.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Kurouski has a great reputation in the biochem dept. However, the COVID shuffle with online classes has been subpar, especially for this course. All lectures are pre-recorded. He blows through slides without heavy detail on exam material. Quizzes every Monday, not very pertinent to exams. TA basically runs recitation and class. Don't get behind
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Tons of quizzes, very difficult exams, and no help from him or his TA. Nice guy, but sucks as a lecturer. If you struggled with Ochem, do not take him. He does not explain topics and relies on his TA to do all of the teaching.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is by far the best professor for BICH 410. He's approachable and makes biochem decently interesting. The final is a good grade booster, he gives at least 10 bonus points on exams, and homework is worth 1/2 an exam grade each week of the exam and has unlimited tries. He's funny and lectures well so definitely attend lecture.

I thoroughly enjoyed Dr. Kurouski. The material was tough and so were the exams, but he definitely cares about his students. I went to office hours to discuss my terrible exam grade, and he was very encouraging and motivating and gave me tips to succeed. His final was old exam questions which we all appreciated. Take him for 410 if you can.

Really great professor. He keeps lecture fun, high-spirited, and keeps you engaged with lots of real-world examples. While the tests are very difficult in my opinion, he does not want to trick you and really wants you to succeed in his class. I would take him again for Biochemistry II if he taught the class. Bonus points offered on every test.

Hard class, but he taught and understood the subject very well. Everything you would need to know is on the powerpoints, so it's easy to catch up if you miss class. He's accommodating to his students and very helpful during office hours.
